title: Sakana-tachi wa Koi o Shiranai
titleJp: 魚たちは恋を知らない
tagline: The Tides of Youth, Sky-Whales, and Clueless High School Romance
summary: At Shiozaki Kaiyō High School, where colossal whales lazily drift across cloud-filled skies and ocean lore is taught alongside mathematics, a brilliant but hopelessly oblivious fish savant navigates maritime folklore, practical sky-fishing classes, and a chaotic harem of sea-loving heroines.
